name: line-bot-ops
description: Operate your own LINE bot from Claude Code: webhook queue health, failed jobs and retries, push, Rich Menu, follower insight.

line_channel_access_token.title: LINE channel access token
line_channel_access_token.description: Long-lived channel access token from the LINE Developers console. Needed by the LINE tools.

supabase_url.title: Supabase URL
supabase_url.description: https://<project>.supabase.co of the bot's database. Leave empty if the bot has no queue.

supabase_service_role_key.title: Supabase service role key
supabase_service_role_key.description: Needed by the queue tools. Leave empty if the bot has no queue.

allow_broadcast.title: Allow broadcast
allow_broadcast.description: Register line_broadcast, which messages every friend and can't be undone.
